newsitem.title: USA: Ault files offering of 1.8 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Ault files offering of 1.8 mln common shrs.

text.p: Ault Inc filed an offering for up to 1.8 million common shares with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.

The company said net proceeds will be used for working capital, repayment of bank debt, purchase of capital equipment and expansion of manufacturing capabilities in South Korea, China and Thailand and for general corporate purposes.
Such purposes may include possible acqusitions of complimentary business or technologies, it said.
The offering will be made through Principal Financial Securities Inc and Cruttenden Roth Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 270,000 additional shares.
